pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions of brown pigment with moderately sharp edge gradients. Patches on the neck and shoulder are larger with more angular vertices compared to the smaller, more rounded patches on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways separating patches. Thickness is non-uniform, appearing wider on the ventral neck and thinning towards the dorsal ridge and posterior. Junction nodes predominantly exhibit trivalent connectivity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck ridge where the mane meets the sky background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, horizontal linear mark of lighter-toned pixels is visible across a large brown patch on the upper mid-flank, characteristic of a healed surface scratch.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent vertical curvilinear skin folds are visible at the base of the neck and across the shoulder region, creating localized shadow gradients.
